entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed with following prayers:-
"1. To issue appropriate suitable orders and directions to the learned Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 3, Allahabad to initiate strict legal action against the accused opposite parties to compel them for making their personal appearance before the court below in Criminal Complaint Case No. 1434 of 2018 (Shadab Azam Ansari vs.
Shaikh Riyaz Abdul Quadir and Others), under Sections 323, 420, 504, 506 IPC of Shadab Azam Ansari vs State Of U.P.And 8 Others on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129581191/
1 Police Station- Ghurpur, Distrcit- Allahabad to cooperate in the proceeding so that the case referred above may be brought to its logical end expeditiously within time bound period to meet out the ends of justice.
2. To issue appropriate suitable orders and directions to the learned Police Commissioner Mumbai Maharashtra to ensure full compliance of order/letter dated 03.08.2021, 02.09.2021 etc passed/issued by the learned Judicial Magistrate Court No. 3 Allahabad U.P. for personal appearance of opposite parties in Criminal Complaint Case No. 1434 of 2018 (Shadab Azam Ansari vs. Shaikh Riyaz Abdul Quadir and Others), under Sections 323, 420, 504, 506 IPC of Police Station- Ghurpur, Distrcit- Allahabad U.P. to cooperate in the proceeding so that the case referred above expeditiously and urgently and to cooperate in proceeding to meet out the ends of justice.
3. To issue appropriate suitable orders and directions to the learned Police Commissioner Mumbai Maharashtra to ensure personal appearance of accused opposite parties before the court below in to cooperate in Criminal Complaint Case No. 1434 of 2018 (Shadab Azam Ansari vs. Shaikh Riyaz Abdul Quadir and Others),
under Sections 323, 420, 504, 506 IPC of Police Station- Ghurpur, Distrcit- Allahabad to cooperate in the proceeding so that the case referred above may be brought to its logical end expeditiously within time bound period to meet out the ends of justice."
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that despite the summoning order issued against the accused persons (opposite party nos. 2 to 6), they are not appearing before the court below and proceedings is pending since 2019.

4. Considered the submissions raised by counsel for the applicant and perused the entire record.
5.

In view of the above, this applications stands disposed of with the direction to the learned Magistrate that if applicant moves an application before the learned Magistrate, the appropriate action shall be taken in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible.
